name: v8-replay
note: V8 stage 1: does replay from round 54's own training distribution stop L2's forgetting without undoing its learning? Every arm starts from round 54 with L2's recipe (lr 1e-4, 24 steps x 4 x 1024 = 98,304 training tokens, top 24 layers, Lion, seed 1301) and L2's curriculum examples, identical (the 976 write examples of the 36 programs of the 12 constant-parameterised v1 families). Replay (rounddata.legacy_share) samples one production round (the v5 mix round 54 was trained on: basics, compose, contrast and novel examples, plus original SFT replay rows) to the given share of the dataset's tokens. The token budget is fixed, so more replay means fewer curriculum exposures: each run records the tokens it actually trained on by source and the exposures per curriculum behaviour (exposures.json). Reference A is L2 itself (76% curriculum tokens; 24% a minimal legacy share of basics writes and 50 replay rows), unchanged.
decision: Screening on development tasks only (the fixed holdout is not evaluated). Replay works if it restores clean dev toward round 54's 27/44 while keeping learning: the trained programs (strict, all 40 inputs) and new constants of their families. Arm C, a second replay share, is chosen from B's result. Any candidate needs two seeds before a decision.
